entries.title: Proverbs 23:1
segments: ¶When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider well who is before thee;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:2
segments: and put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:3
segments: Be not desirous of his dainties; for they are deceitful food.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:4
segments: ¶Weary not thyself to become rich; cease from thine own intelligence:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:5
segments: wilt thou set thine eyes upon it, it is gone; for indeed it maketh itself wings and it flieth away as an eagle towards the heavens.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:6
segments: ¶Eat thou not the food of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainties.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:7
segments: For as he thinketh in his soul, so is he. Eat and drink! will he say unto thee; but his heart is not with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:8
segments: Thy morsel which thou hast eaten must thou vomit up, and thou wilt have wasted thy sweet words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:9
segments: ¶Speak not in the ears of a foolish [man], for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:10
segments: ¶Remove not the ancient landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:11
segments: for their redeemer is mighty; he will plead their cause against thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:12
segments: ¶Apply thy heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:13
segments: Withhold not correction from the child; for [if] thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:14
segments: thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from Sheol.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:15
segments: My son, if thy heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:16
segments: and my reins shall exult, when thy lips speak right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:17
segments: ¶Let not thy heart envy sinners, but [be thou] in the fear of Jehovah all the day;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:18
segments: for surely there is a result, and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:19
segments: ¶Thou, my son, hear and be wise, and direct thy heart in the way.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:20
segments: Be not among winebibbers, among riotous eaters of flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:21
segments: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty; and drowsiness clotheth with rags.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:22
segments: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:23
segments: Buy the truth, and sell it not; wisdom, and instruction, and intelligence.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:24
segments: The father of a righteous [man] shall greatly rejoice, and he that begetteth a wise [son] shall have joy of him:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:25
segments: let thy father and thy mother have joy, and let her that bore thee rejoice.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:26
segments: My son, give me thy heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:27
segments: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:28
segments: She also lieth in wait as a robber, and increaseth the treacherous among men.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:29
segments: ¶Who hath woe? Who hath sorrow? Who contentions? Who complaining? Who wounds without cause? Who redness of eyes?

entries.title: Proverbs 23:30
segments: --They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to try mixed wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:31
segments: Look not upon the wine when it is red, when it sparkleth in the cup, and goeth down smoothly:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:32
segments: at the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:33
segments: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thy heart shall speak froward things;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:34
segments: and thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, and as he that lieth down upon the top of a mast:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:35
segments: --''They have smitten me, [and] I am not sore; they have beaten me, [and] I knew it not. When shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.''
